title: Classify sales motion before coaching
content: Determine the primary buyer job and sales motion before recommending language, scoring behavior, or applying a benchmark. Keep a secondary motion when a service visit becomes a replacement discussion or a technician introduces an adjacent need.
applies_when: Any sales guidance or analysis begins
exceptions: None
prohibited: Applying a universal script before context is known

title: Proof must match the claim
content: Use technical evidence for condition and design claims, credentials and relevant work for capability claims, written scope for commitments, and performance records for commercial reliability. Reviews support reputation but do not prove a diagnosis.
applies_when: A seller makes a material claim
exceptions: None
prohibited: Using unrelated proof or testimonial as technical evidence

title: Separate fact inference report and unknown
content: Label observed and measured facts, customer-reported information, professional inference, and unknowns separately. Ask for additional evidence when the distinction could change scope, urgency, safety, price, or next step.
exceptions: None
prohibited: Presenting inference as verified fact

title: Trust begins before arrival
content: Response speed, booking clarity, realistic windows, fee disclosure, appointment confirmation, identity, and delay updates influence buyer confidence before the field interaction.
applies_when: Inbound residential demand is being handled
exceptions: Emergency safety instructions follow approved protocol
prohibited: Diagnosing complex technical work during booking

title: Qualified booking rate
content: Qualified booking rate equals booked qualified appointments divided by qualified two-way calls. Define qualified, duplicate, spam, out-of-area, and cancellation rules before comparison.
exceptions: Use all-call booking only when denominator is explicitly all calls
prohibited: Comparing rates with different denominator rules

title: Discovery question families
content: Cover relevant situation, problem, implication, outcome, decision, and constraint information. Ask only questions that could change diagnosis, recommendation, implementation, or next step.
applies_when: The buyer and seller are defining a need
exceptions: Short urgent calls require only safety and dispatch essentials
prohibited: Forcing every question family into every interaction

title: Focused discovery beats interrogation
content: Explore a limited number of material issues in depth and distribute questions through a natural conversation. Use response quality rather than question count as the primary standard.
exceptions: Gong counts and ratios are not universal targets
prohibited: Front-loading questions as a checklist

title: Confirm the problem before solving
content: Summarize verified condition, unknowns, buyer priority, proportional consequence, decision path, and constraints in the buyer's language. Ask for correction before proposing.
applies_when: A recommendation is about to be formed
exceptions: Immediate safety stabilization may precede full discovery
prohibited: Pitching from unconfirmed assumptions

title: Proportional implication
content: Help the buyer understand a plausible consequence only when it follows from verified evidence. State uncertainty and avoid catastrophic language when severity or timing is unknown.
exceptions: Approved emergency safety protocols may require direct instruction
prohibited: Inflating fear or certainty to create urgency

title: Options must be viable
content: Every presented option must be safe, legal, technically viable, and deliverable. Differences should be material in scope, performance, lifespan, risk, warranty, convenience, disruption, or timing.
exceptions: A single viable option may be appropriate
prohibited: Unsafe decoy or fake premium anchor

title: Choice architecture is contextual
content: Organize options around buyer priorities and reduce irrelevant complexity. More choices are not always better because overload depends on choice complexity, decision difficulty, preference uncertainty, and decision goal.
applies_when: A buyer faces multiple attributes or options
exceptions: Do not infer a fixed ideal option count
prohibited: Treating three options as a universal law

title: Recommend one path
content: After explaining viable choices, recommend the option that best fits the buyer's verified priorities and explain the reasoning. Make residual risk and tradeoffs visible.
exceptions: A formal low-bid process may limit recommendation format
prohibited: Defaulting to the highest price

title: ACORN objection sequence
content: Acknowledge, Clarify, Observe whether the issue is isolated, Respond with relevant evidence or a viable adjustment, and establish the Next step. Diagnose before rebutting.
applies_when: A buyer expresses concern or hesitation
exceptions: A clear no should be respected without forced isolation
prohibited: Reflexive rebuttal or repeated closing pressure

title: Price objection meanings
content: Price concern may reflect scope mismatch, expected budget, available cash, financing structure, trust, timing, missing stakeholder, or polite refusal. Clarify the comparison before defending price.
applies_when: The buyer says price is too high
exceptions: None
prohibited: Assuming affordability or discounting immediately

title: Secure the appropriate commitment
content: Ask directly for the next commitment that matches the buyer's decision stage. Valid commitments include appointment, inspection, stakeholder meeting, proposal review, paid design, pilot, agreement, signed work, pause, or no-go.
applies_when: An interaction reaches a decision point
exceptions: Safety action may be immediate
prohibited: Treating same-call revenue as the only valid outcome

title: Follow-up must add value
content: Each follow-up should answer a question, make scope easier to compare, involve a stakeholder, supply approved proof, clarify truthful timing, or confirm whether the need remains active.
exceptions: Transactional reminders may be concise
prohibited: Repeated just-checking-in messages or invented urgency

title: Repair versus replace requires evidence
content: Consider verified condition, safety, failure frequency, repair availability, remaining life, performance, customer time horizon, disruption, warranty, and total exposure. Do not use age alone as the decision.
applies_when: Repair and replacement are both discussed
exceptions: Unsafe or prohibited repair is excluded when verified
prohibited: Predetermined replacement based on age or sales target

title: HVAC replacement proof
content: Replacement confidence can be supported by load calculations, airflow and duct evaluation, properly matched equipment documentation, commissioning measurements, written model details, warranty, and price and scope comparison.
applies_when: HVAC replacement or system design is proposed
exceptions: Qualified roles and local requirements govern technical work
prohibited: Guaranteed savings or rule-of-thumb sizing as certainty

title: Plumbing consequence guardrail
content: Use camera evidence, pressure readings, leak detection, material identification, and accessible condition to support scope. A symptom does not prove collapse, contamination, or whole-system failure.
applies_when: A major plumbing scope is considered
exceptions: Qualified emergency protocols apply
prohibited: Catastrophizing without evidence

title: Electrical safety claims require verification
content: Use measurements, inspection findings, equipment ratings, load calculations, verified adopted code, and permit requirements. Older or crowded equipment alone does not establish immediate fire risk.
applies_when: Safety or code is part of the recommendation
exceptions: Approved immediate hazard protocol
prohibited: Unsupported fire or code claim

title: Storm event is not property damage proof
content: NOAA storm records and FEMA declarations can support market research and inspection timing, but they do not prove damage to a specific property, causation, insurance coverage, or claim approval.
applies_when: Weather or disaster data is used
exceptions: None
prohibited: Claiming damage or coverage from area-level data

title: Insurance outcome boundary
content: A contractor may document observed conditions and explain its process, but should not promise coverage, claim approval, settlement amount, or deductible treatment. Jurisdiction and company policy govern insurance-related conduct.
exceptions: Licensed public adjuster or attorney roles require separate policy
prohibited: Coverage promise or unlawful deductible practice

title: Remodeling separates concept feasibility and contract
content: Treat concept, site investigation, feasibility, design, selections, pricing, and construction as distinct decision stages. Early prices and dates should be ranges with assumptions until the scope supports commitment.
exceptions: Standardized scopes may progress faster
prohibited: Presenting conceptual estimate as fixed construction commitment

title: Recurring service outcome limits
content: State cadence, service standard, exclusions, customer responsibilities, weather or biology factors, callback terms, and cancellation. Avoid guarantees when external conditions materially affect control.
exceptions: Written company guarantees may be explained exactly
prohibited: Absolute outcome claim beyond written terms

title: Integrated pest management value
content: Frame pest service around inspection, prevention, exclusion, monitoring, and proportional treatment. EPA describes IPM as using pest and control information to manage damage with the least feasible hazard to people, property, and the environment.
exceptions: Licensed professional and label requirements govern treatment
prohibited: Chemical fear or unlicensed recommendation

title: Financing shows full cost
content: Present cash price, financed amount, required APR and term disclosures, payment, fees, promotional conditions, and material risks using approved lender information. A monthly payment is context, not a substitute for total cost.
exceptions: Exact disclosure duties come from lender and jurisdiction policy
prohibited: Hiding cash price dealer fee APR term or deferred-interest condition

title: Cooling-Off Rule baseline
content: Certain sales made at a consumer's home or covered temporary location may carry a federal three-business-day cancellation right. Check transaction scope, exceptions, disclosures, and additional state law before advising.
applies_when: A covered in-home sale may occur
exceptions: Federal rule has exclusions and states may differ
prohibited: Declaring applicability without transaction facts

title: Lead RRP routing trigger
content: EPA RRP requirements can apply when compensated work disturbs painted surfaces in covered pre-1978 homes or child-occupied facilities. Route certification, training, pre-renovation education, and work-practice questions to current verified policy.
applies_when: Work may disturb paint in a covered property
exceptions: Property and work exceptions require verification
prohibited: Assuming the rule never applies to a trade

title: Commercial stakeholder map
content: Map operational user, technical evaluator, facility or project leader, estimator, procurement, finance, safety, executive sponsor, and blockers. Record influence, concern, evidence needed, relationship strength, and next action.
exceptions: Small owner-operated accounts may combine roles
prohibited: Treating one friendly contact as complete access

title: Champion requires action
content: A champion is a stakeholder with influence who actively helps the decision advance by sharing information, facilitating access, clarifying criteria, or advocating internally. Friendliness alone is not evidence.
exceptions: Role labels may remain tentative
prohibited: Forecast inflation from rapport

title: Commercial stage follows buyer evidence
content: Pipeline stages should be supported by buyer actions or verified conditions such as a confirmed need, provided data, site access, stakeholder meeting, evaluation criteria, shortlist, or negotiated next step. Seller activity is not progress by itself.
applies_when: A commercial opportunity is staged or forecast
exceptions: Early signal stage may use sourced inference
prohibited: Advancing stage because an email was sent

title: Go-no-go protects margin and capacity
content: Evaluate strategic fit, capability, capacity, access, need, timing, decision visibility, competitive position, scope, commercial terms, margin, and relationship value before investing in a pursuit.
applies_when: A bid or project pursuit is considered
exceptions: Authorized strategic bids must still document economics and risk
prohibited: Bidding only for activity or visibility

title: Seller-doer shared model
content: Business developers create access and coordinate continuity, while technical leaders diagnose, validate, and establish delivery confidence. CRM ownership, next action, estimating input, and handoff responsibility must be explicit.
exceptions: One person may hold both roles in a small firm
prohibited: Unowned handoff or contradictory commitments

title: Commercial safety value requires proof
content: Translate verified safety systems into buyer risk reduction using program elements, training, incident information, coordination practices, and site plans. Do not promise zero incidents or claim superiority without comparable evidence.
applies_when: Safety is a selection or execution concern
exceptions: Company counsel and safety leadership approve claims
prohibited: Zero-risk claim or unverified statistic

title: Consensus is part of commercial value
content: Help stakeholders use shared definitions of problem, evidence, criteria, risk, and next step. Do not rely on a single contact to translate the case internally.
exceptions: A sole decision maker may still seek user input
prohibited: Manipulating conflict or bypassing authorized process

title: Campaign trigger is not customer fact
content: Use a seasonal, property, account, permit, weather, or project signal as a reason to investigate or offer help. Do not phrase an aggregate or inferred trigger as verified knowledge about the recipient.
exceptions: First-party verified account facts may be stated accurately
prohibited: Pretending to know a specific unverified condition

title: Campaign sequence adds new value
content: Build touches around relevance, approved proof, decision support, specific invitation, and respectful close-the-loop. Each touch should add information rather than repeat the same ask.
exceptions: Operational reminders may repeat essential details
prohibited: Spam cadence or false scarcity

title: CAN-SPAM baseline
content: Commercial email requires accurate sender and subject information, identification and postal-address practices where required, a clear opt-out mechanism, and timely honoring of opt-outs under FTC guidance. Review current law and company policy.
exceptions: Transactional messages can be treated differently under law
prohibited: Deceptive header subject or ignored opt-out

title: Calls and texts need channel review
content: Consent, purpose, technology, calling party, number status, revocation, time, and state law can change whether a call or text is permitted. Generate a review checklist rather than declaring compliance.
applies_when: Outbound calling or texting is proposed
exceptions: Emergency and other exemptions require specific review
prohibited: Assuming a purchased lead grants every form of consent

title: Account health precedes expansion
content: Review delivery quality, unresolved complaints, promise variance, payment, margin, relationship coverage, renewal, and current need before recommending cross-sell or expansion.
exceptions: Urgent unrelated need may still require immediate help
prohibited: Selling around an unresolved delivery failure

title: Quality-adjusted outcome
content: Evaluate close or win rate together with gross margin, cancellation, financing fallout, callback, rework, complaint, promise variance, review sentiment, renewal, and referral. A booked job that causes downstream harm is not a clean win.
exceptions: Lagging outcomes require appropriate measurement windows
prohibited: Ranking sellers by revenue or close rate alone

title: Benchmark is not a target
content: Before applying an external number, match sales motion, lead source, service mix, ticket, geography, season, role, tenure, definition, sample size, and quality outcomes. Preserve population, period, source, and limitations.
exceptions: Internal policy targets are labeled as policy
prohibited: Universalizing an unmatched benchmark

title: Market sizing uses TAM SAM SOM
content: Define the market unit, then calculate theoretical total demand, serviceable demand within geography and capability, and realistic near-term capture based on capacity, channels, competition, and conversion. Show formulas and ranges.
exceptions: Account-based markets may use named-account coverage instead
prohibited: False precision from unrelated percentages

title: Housing data creates segments not leads
content: ACS and AHS data can support segments based on ownership, housing age, condition, improvements, demographics, and geography. Aggregate data does not prove a specific homeowner's need or readiness.
exceptions: Lawfully sourced property-specific facts may be stated with attribution
prohibited: Personalizing an unverified condition

title: Permits are activity not service demand
content: Building permits indicate authorized new residential construction and can inform growth research. They do not equal starts, completions, replacement demand, contractor revenue, or an individual opportunity.
exceptions: Project-specific permit records can support a named project signal
prohibited: Equating permits with booked work

title: Labor projections are strategic context
content: BLS national occupational projections and openings inform labor-market strategy but do not establish local customer demand, seller capacity, or available workers. Use state and area data for territory analysis.
exceptions: None
prohibited: Treating national growth as local sales forecast

title: Critical violation overrides score
content: Fabricated evidence, false safety code insurance savings or scarcity claims, concealed financing terms, discrimination, unauthorized work or recording, and knowingly undeliverable promises trigger critical review regardless of numeric performance.
applies_when: Behavior or generated output is scored
exceptions: None
prohibited: Passing a harmful interaction because it closed

title: Coach earliest causal beam
content: Identify the earliest weak TRUSS beam that materially caused the downstream miss. Coach Understand before Solve when the recommendation failed because discovery was incomplete, and Trust before discovery when the buyer would not engage because expectations were unclear.
applies_when: An interaction or outcome is diagnosed
exceptions: Critical violations are addressed first
prohibited: Defaulting every loss to closing technique

title: Practice reveals facts only when earned
content: A simulated buyer should disclose hidden facts only in response to relevant questions, proof, or trust. Score adaptation and decision quality rather than keywords or a forced win.
exceptions: Guided beginner mode may provide prompts
prohibited: Cooperative answer dumping or automatic close

title: Changing knowledge belongs in retrieval
content: Use source-tagged retrieval for proprietary, specialized, and changing facts. Keep product behavior in versioned instructions and evaluate both retrieval and response behavior before release.
applies_when: TRUSS knowledge or behavior is implemented
exceptions: None
prohibited: Using fine-tuning as the only changing knowledge store
